Executed 81 of 84 test cases across UI and API layers against the Test TH Regional tenant. Core CRUD works end-to-end (create static/dynamic groups, edit, deactivate/reactivate, view members, remove member, view linked policies). Identified 5 genuine defects (1 P1, 2 P2, 2 P3); a further 4 originally-flagged items were reclassified as not build defects once the wireframe was made authoritative (see below). Not ready for sign-off until the P1 (SN-18-BE001, breaks Workforce) and the P2s are resolved. 5 cases FAIL (mapping to SN-18-BE001 / FE001 / FE002); the member-picker (SN-18-FE004) and console-400 (SN-18-FE005) defects surface in blocked cases. 29 cases are blocked on unprovisioned non-admin users, undeployed endpoints (/policy-links, /activate), a single-tenant environment, or fixtures that cannot be built. 3 of the 84 suite cases were folded into related cases during execution.

Defects Identified (5)

#1SN-18-BE001P1

Departments API endpoint missing — breaks Workforce (SN-66) integration

GET /core/api/v1/groups/departments?entityId=... returns 400 ('departments' is not a valid Guid) — the router treats departments as a group ID. Workforce's department filter dropdown reads from this endpoint and is unusable without it. Fix: expose the departments endpoint at the correct path.

Affected test cases: TC-079, TC-080, TC-084

#2SN-18-FE001P2

Unsaved Settings changes discarded with no confirmation

The wireframe designs a discard dialog ('You have unsaved changes. Discard?'), but the build never fires it — editing a group then clicking X / Close / Cancel discards changes silently (data loss). Fix: wire up the discard-confirmation modal on every close path when the Settings tab has unsaved changes.

Affected test cases: TC-017

#3SN-18-FE002P2

'Change mode' button is a no-op

The wireframe has a 'Change mode' button, but clicking it (static ↔ dynamic) does nothing — no modal, no transition. Blocks all four mode-change cases. Fix: wire the button to open the confirmation modal.

Affected test cases: TC-037 (cascades to TC-038, TC-039, TC-040)

#4SN-18-FE004P3

Add-member picker unavailable

The wireframe designs the employee search picker, but opening a static group's Members tab and clicking '+ Add member' shows 'Employee list is temporarily unavailable.' Fix: repair the employee-search endpoint behind the picker.

Affected test cases: TC-027, TC-028

#5SN-18-FE005P3

Console 400 on every rule-builder open

Each rule-builder open with a Department field fires GET .../groups/departments → 400 (9+ console errors during the run). Same root cause as SN-18-BE001. Fix: resolved by fixing SN-18-BE001.

Affected test cases: TC-021, TC-022

Reclassified — not build defects (4)

Originally flagged, but verified against the authoritative wireframe these are not defects: the feature was never designed in the wireframe, or the behavior is a spec/implementation reconciliation rather than a broken build. Kept here for tracking; not filed as bugs.

SN-18-FE003NOT A DEFECT

Duplicate-name soft warning never designed

Spec AC-CG6 wants a soft 'already exists' warning on blur, but the wireframe has no such element (the only 'already exists' string is a JS comment about policy-link dedup). The build matches the wireframe; the hard 409 at save works correctly. Action: spec/design enhancement, not a build defect.

Test case: TC-013

SN-18-BE002NOT A DEFECT

Reactivation works via the UI

Reactivation is functional through the row menu (reactivateGroup). Only the dedicated POST /{id}/activate REST verb 404s. Not user-facing. Action: API-contract note — confirm whether a dedicated activate verb is required.

Test case: TC-044

SN-18-BE003NOT A DEFECT

No DELETE by design

The wireframe has no Delete action — deactivate is the soft-delete mechanism. DELETE /{id} returning 405 is therefore by design; DELETE-as-alias was only a spec §13 convenience nothing calls. Action: amend the spec, not the build.

Test case: TC-045

SN-18-BE004NOT A DEFECT

Optimistic locking — impl stricter than spec

A stale-version PATCH returns 409 VERSION_MISMATCH. Neither the wireframe nor the spec actually asks for locking (the spec says last-write-wins), so the implementation is stricter, not broken. Action: spec/implementation reconciliation — decide which behavior is canonical.

Test case: TC-076

Recommended next steps

  1. File the 5 genuine defects (SN-18-BE001, FE001, FE002, FE004, FE005) under SN-18; start with SN-18-BE001 (P1) — it breaks the Workforce filter. The 4 reclassified items are spec/API reconciliation, not bugs.

  3. Confirm deployment of /policy-links and /activate endpoints with the dev team.
  4. Clarify the activate/deactivate API contract (dedicated POST endpoints vs PATCH status) and reconcile the optimistic-locking behavior (SN-18-BE004) with the intended Phase 1 design.
  5. Re-run the failed + blocked clusters once the above land.
